current_universe.description: East Equity Agent trading universe - AI supply chain core plus large-cap market leaders with an AI/tech bias, plus diversified non-tech sleeves (financials, energy/power, gold/materials, healthcare, consumer/industrial leaders) for regime breadth. Long-only. US-listed common equities >=$1B market cap only; every ticker appears in exactly ONE sector. Edit deliberately; the validator hard-rejects any ticker not listed here.

anchored_vwap.note: Volume-weighted average price paid since the anchor event. Above it, buyers since the anchor are collectively in profit and it tends to act as support; below it, as resistance. This is a measured level, not a chart read.

discovery_candidates.note: Weekly broad-market discovery sweep for the Sunday universe review. Candidates ranked by a momentum/relative-strength blend (0.35*mom_3m + 0.35*rs_3m + 0.15*mom_1m + 0.15*rs_1m, fractions x100); universe members excluded at runtime; liquidity floor $20M median 20d dollar volume (below = dropped); trailing completed bars only. These are CANDIDATES for curation research, not trade signals.

breadth.note: 897 scored names from the discovery pool (S&P 500 + Russell 1000 + NDX + EM ADR), universe members excluded. Weekly cadence: this is a rotation read, not a daily one.
